verdict.rationale: n8n can be fully self-hosted on a user's own infrastructure or private cloud, which lets AI-native users control exactly where their data resides, and this is corroborated by community reports of self-hosting for data-sensitive use cases (e.g. avoiding Zapier due to client data concerns). However, there is no explicit documentation of a managed-cloud region/residency selection feature (e.g. choosing EU vs US data centers for n8n Cloud), so the story is only addressed via the self-hosting path rather than a first-class residency control. Missing for 10: explicit cloud region-selection options, data residency certifications/compliance documentation for hosted offering.
